en.headline: 3 issues opened on openchamber; 3 commits to sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu
en.summary: sogeisetsu made 3 commits to their own repository sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu. Three issues were opened on openchamber/openchamber, all related to commit d9fbf6b which removed the sidebar header button for multi-run functionality. Issue #4337 (opened 12:52 UTC) reported that multi-run docs still reference the removed sidebar header button; openchamber-bot[bot] confirmed the issue at 12:55 UTC, and btriapitsyn closed it at 14:56 UTC. Issue #4345 (opened 15:10 UTC) noted that the command palette 'Parallel run' shares the checkbox-multiple icon with the sidebar 'Select sessions' toggle; openchamber-bot[bot] replied at 15:15 UTC noting that multi-run's identity elsewhere uses ArrowsMerge. Issue #4346 (opened 15:10 UTC) flagged that SidebarHeader.test.tsx still passes despite onOpenMultiRun and canOpenMultiRun being removed in d9fbf6b. No pull requests, reviews, or releases occurred during the window.
